_doc: Schema for benchmarks/loop/decision.json — the agent's machine-readable output contract.
_instructions: Write this file as your LAST action. Missing file = crash → rollback.
run_id: benchmark run ID from your main evaluation
changes_summary: One-line description of what you changed
reasoning: 2-4 sentences explaining your hypothesis and findings
ux_recommendations: REQUIRED. Specific conctl tooling feedback: missing commands, missing filters/flags, too-many-step lookups, awkward output formats, or missing data views you encountered this iteration. If none, write 'No issues — conctl commands were sufficient for this iteration.'

_verdicts.continue: Changes show improvement or promise — loop continues
_verdicts.rollback: Changes didn't help — revert to baseline
